title: Rules, Traces and Routing Statistics: Training and Calibration Data for Open Models on ARC-AGI-2
abstract: arXiv:2611.06827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study which training and calibration data help three open models solve ARC-AGI-2 tasks when the solver runs offline on four L4 GPUs for at most 12 hours. We compare data offline on public tasks and report 189 runs on the 120 hidden semi-private tasks. For the NVARC Qwen3-4B grid model, we built a corpus of 12,000 executable rules in a typed language and 95,993 tasks; a rule is admitted only if its behaviour on a fixed probe set differs from that of every admitted rule, and a task only if its pairs refute a shortlist of nearest competing rules and defeat 12 shortcut solvers. Continued fine-tuning on 1,920 real task records with revised four-GPU scheduling raised the semi-private score from 28.96 (mean of the released model) to 33.06 (mean of five runs, best 34.86); no checkpoint trained with synthetic tasks, even all 95,993 of them, improved on the real-task model. translated_title: 规则、轨迹与路由统计：面向开放模型在ARC-AGI-2上的训练与校准数据
translated_abstract: 我们研究了哪些训练与校准数据能够帮助三个开放模型在求解器于四块L4 GPU上离线运行至多12小时的约束下解决ARC-AGI-2任务。我们在公开任务上对数据进行了离线比较，并在120个隐藏的半私有任务上报告了189次运行结果。对于NVARC Qwen3-4B网格模型，我们构建了一个包含12,000条类型化语言可执行规则的语料库以及95,993个任务；一条规则只有在固定探测集上的行为与所有已被采纳的规则都不同时才会被采纳；一个任务只有在其样本对能够反驳最邻近竞争规则的候选名单并击败12个捷径求解器时才会被采纳。在1,920条真实任务记录上进行持续微调并改进四GPU调度后，半私有分数从28.96（发布模型的均值）提升至33.06（五次运行的均值，最佳为34.86）；没有任何使用合成任务训练的检查点——即使使用全部95,993个合成任务——能够超越真实任务模型。对于Qwen3.8-27B推理模型，我们在其自身的1,036条（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 通过在类型化语言中构建12,000条经行为去重的可执行规则和95,993个经过捷径求解器过滤的高质量合成任务，并结合真实任务记录微调与四GPU调度优化，将开放模型在ARC-AGI-2半私有集上的分数从28.96提升至33.06，同时证明纯合成数据训练无法超越真实数据模型。
en_tdlr: By curating 12,000 behavior-deduplicated executable rules in a typed language and 95,993 synthetic tasks filtered against 12 shortcut solvers, then fine-tuning on 1,920 real task records with revised four-GPU scheduling, the study lifts open-model scores on ARC-AGI-2 semi-private tasks from 28.96 to 33.06, showing that synthetic-task training alone never surpasses real-data fine-tuning.
